name: cinna-agent-contract
title: Cinna agent folder contract
description: The machine-readable half of the cinna-core start-kit: the manifest schema, the folder model and the agent/root templates. Everything a tool needs to create, read, validate and export an agent folder without reading a guide.

refresh.notes: base_url is the default; a linked Cinna instance serves the same two paths under its own origin. The desktop and kit.py refresh swap the install_dir atomically and never edit it by hand.
